purpose: Teach: 茎/世俗/パラダイム/フェミニズム/中南米/遠距離/金星/生死

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、組織の幹と茎、つまり中核と末端を意識しろ
lines.en: Our company—understand the core and the periphery. The trunk and the branches.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate opening. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Slight pause before the clarification. Voice steady, not rushed. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。世俗的な広告は控えめにします
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep our advertising measured and restrained.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in the voice. Brisk but not hurried. Picking up the thread of the directive without overstepping. Professional and grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界のパラダイム転換に備えろ
lines.en: Our company—prepare for a paradigm shift in the industry.
lines.style: Firm, forward-leaning. Weight on the word 'prepare.' Not a suggestion but a strategic imperative. Calm but resolute. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。フェミニズム視点を組織に取り入れます
lines.en: Yes. We'll integrate a feminist perspective into the organization.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment. Confident on the commitment. Not defensive, not performative—simply stating what will be done. Matter-of-fact and direct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中南米市場への参入を検討しろ
lines.en: Our company—consider entry into the Latin American market.
lines.style: Deliberate, expansive. Slight lean on 'consider'—it's not tentative, it's strategic positioning. The voice of someone mapping territory. Steady and purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。遠距離勤務の社員も支援します
lines.en: Yes. We'll also support our remote workforce through this transition.
lines.style: Affirmative but thoughtful. Adding a layer of care to the directive—practical thinking. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Measured and inclusive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、宇宙関連の事業展開を狙え、金星も視野
lines.en: Our company—pursue ventures in space. Venus is in scope.
lines.style: Bold, almost matter-of-fact in its audacity. Crisp articulation. No hesitation, no apologizing for ambition. The voice of someone who thinks in decades. Commanding but not theatrical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社の生死を分ける決断は慎重にします
lines.en: Yes. We'll be careful with decisions that determine the company's survival.
lines.style: Serious, grounded. A moment of quiet conviction here—acknowledging the weight. Not panicked, but respectfully cautious. The voice of someone who understands the stakes.
